entries.01ecaa20b3597ff1: It makes automobiles and automotive parts and earns revenue by selling them through sales companies in Japan and overseas. Its reportable segments are by region rather than by product; of net sales of ¥4,918,172 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥2,561,746 million in North America, ¥900,173 million in Japan, ¥859,557 million in Europe and ¥596,696 million in other regions.
entries.0d9a7350d0eb85c9: Sales companies in Japan and overseas (the channels that sell Mazda vehicles)
entries.172d489f8fdf8315: In Japan, sales companies such as Kanto Mazda Co., Ltd. sell vehicles, and overseas, Mazda Motor of America, Inc. in North America, Mazda Motors (Deutschland) GmbH in Europe, Mazda Australia Pty.Ltd. in other regions and others sell them. Global sales volume for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,223,000 units, broken down as follows: North America 582,000 units (of which the United States 395,000 units), other markets 262,000 units, Europe 164,000 units, Japan 144,000 units and China 71,000 units. No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.188455d84f6f1f9f: This is the domestic business. Mazda Motor Corporation makes automobiles and parts at the Head Office Plant in Fuchu-cho, Aki-gun, Hiroshima Prefecture, the Hofu Plant in Hofu, Yamaguchi Prefecture and elsewhere, and sales companies such as Kanto Mazda Co., Ltd. and Tokai Mazda Sales Co., Ltd. sell them to customers. The company sells directly to some large customers. Because automobiles produced in Japan are also shipped to overseas sales companies, in the fiscal year ended March 2026 there were intersegment internal sales of ¥2,457,705 million against sales to external customers of ¥900,173 million.

entries.66e7334954ec8654: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,579 million; by segment, North America recorded ¥167,536 million, other regions ¥32,712 million and Europe ¥18,026 million, against which Japan recorded an operating loss of ¥161,820 million (plus an adjustment of −¥4,875 million). The annual securities report explains the operating loss in Japan as due to a decline in shipments, mainly to the United States, which were affected by tariffs, together with rising raw material prices and the effects of tariff measures.

entries.c16d68443668735c: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,918,172 million. By customer location, revenue was ¥616,037 million in Japan, ¥1,904,129 million in the United States, ¥661,032 million in North America (excluding the United States), ¥865,681 million in Europe and ¥871,293 million in other regions. Because revenue from external customers in the automotive-related business exceeds 90% of revenue, a breakdown by product and service is not stated in the annual securities report.

entries.e367b1be4f296b41: In Japan, the company manufactures automobiles, and automotive parts are manufactured by the company and Kurashiki Kako Co., Ltd. and others. Overseas, companies such as Mazda Motor Manufacturing de Mexico S.A. de C.V. in Mexico and Auto Alliance (Thailand) Co., Ltd. in Thailand manufacture automobiles and parts. entries.e5f94039133a6ea8: It consists of Mazda Motor Corporation, 71 consolidated subsidiaries and 21 equity-method affiliates, and is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles and automotive parts and related businesses (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.e936f51c810cb4df: This is the North American business, managed by Mazda Motor of America, Inc. and the company.
